description: Sony has announced the PS Plus monthly games lineup for July. This month, PS Plus will add Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, For the King 2, and CrossCode. All three games will be available starting July 7, free of cost to PS Plus Essential, Extra, and Deluxe/Premium members.
title: PS Plus Monthly Games for July Include Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, For the King 2 and CrossCode

description: Amazon is expected to offer discounts on fitness trackers and smart rings during the Prime Day Sale 2026, scheduled from July 4 to July 6. The sale includes offers on products from Oura, Samsung, Garmin, Huawei and Whoop. The Oura Ring 4 is set to receive its biggest price cut in India, with up to 30 percent off and a starting price of Rs. 11,990. Effective sale prices include eligible bank offers, while select products will also support No Cost EMI.
title: Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026: Top Deals on Fitness Trackers and Smart Rings

description: Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026 early deals are now live in India, bringing discounts on various electronics, including smartphones, laptops, TVs, cameras, wireless speakers, truly wireless stereo (TWS) headsets, wearables, and smart home appliances, before the sale event starts on July 4. The company has listed the OnePlus 13, the company’s last-generation flagship handset, which was launched in India in January 2025, at a discounted price of Rs. 54,999. Apart from direct price cuts, you can also avail an instant discount of 10 percent with a credit card of Axis Bank and SBI during the Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026.
title: Amazon Prime Day Sale: Early Deals on Smartphones From Top Brands Like OnePlus, Redmi and More Revealed

description: The Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026 is all set to take place from July 4 through July 6. The e-commerce giant’s three-day shopping event is expected to offer discounts across a wide range of products, including smartphones, home appliances, TVs, laptops, audio products, and more. Shoppers will be able to purchase products at considerably lower prices than their usual market rates. Ahead of the sale event, Amazon has revealed early deals on home appliances like air conditioners and refrigerators. So, if you’re planning an upgrade, then the Prime Day Sale 2026 is a great avenue to do so.
title: Amazon Prime Day Sale 2026: Early Deals on ACs, Washing Machines and Other Home Appliances

description: Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition will be launched in India on July 7, along with the standard edition of the upcoming smartphone. The London-based tech firm touts the exclusive variant as a limited-edition collectible”. The company has also revealed the design of the limited edition handset. The phone is shown to sport the IPL franchise’s insignia on the back, finished in black. The Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition will sport a similar shade of red as RCB’s jersey. The handset will be available for purchase at an exclusive drop event on the day of its launch at the Nothing Bengaluru store.
title: Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition Design, Colour Revealed Days Ahead of Debut

description: Redmi Note 17 series will be launched in China this month, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday in a post on Weibo. The Xiaomi sub-brand claims that the Redmi Note 17 series will bring enhanced “quality, screen, battery life, and user experience” (translated from Chinese) over its predecessor. As part of the announcement, the company also revealed that it has sold more than 500 million units of Redmi Note series phone globally in the last 12 years. The upcoming Redmi Note 17 lineup is confirmed to debut as a mid-range smartphone series.
title: Redmi Note 17 Series Launch Timeline Teased, Company Touts Display Upgrades and Longer Battery Life

description: Lava has launched the Probuds T51 true wireless earbuds and Xscape 13° Neckband in India. The Probuds T51 features 12.4mm drivers, hybrid ANC of up to 50dB, Bluetooth 5.4 and up to 60 hours of battery life. The Xscape 13° Neckband offers 10mm drivers, three EQ modes, a 40ms low latency mode and up to 70 hours of battery life. Both support dual device pairing, fast charging, IPX4 splash resistance and voice assistant support.
title: Lava Probuds T51, Xscape 13° Neckband With Up to 70 Hours Battery Life Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Garmin Forerunner 70, Forerunner 170, and Forerunner 170 Music smartwatches launched in India with 5ATM rating for water resistance and 1.2-inch AMOLED displays. They feature a wrist-based heart rate monitor and a Pulse Ox sensor for blood oxygen saturation monitoring. The Forerunner 70 is advertised to deliver up to 13 days of battery life in smartwatch mode. The Forerunner 170 and Forerunner 170 Music are advertised to offer up to 10 days of battery life in smartwatch mode.
title: Garmin Forerunner 70, Forerunner 170, Forerunner 170 Music Launched in India With 1.2-Inch Display, Up to 13 Days Battery Life

description: Amazon Prime Day 2026 Sale will run from July 4 through July 6 in India. The three-day shopping event is limited to Prime members. Just ahead of the sale, Amazon has started teasing several deals. Several smartphones priced under Rs. 50,000, including the Samsung Galaxy A56 5G and  Redmi Turbo 5, are confirmed to see price cuts in the sale. Shoppers can further reduce prices with additional bank-based offers.
title: Amazon Prime Day 2026 Sale: Top Deals on Smartphones Under Rs. 50,000

description: Himanshu Tandon on Thursday announced that he is stepping down from his role as CMF India's Vice President, Business. Tandon has announced his exit from the firm nearly 10 months after he joined CMF India in August last year. However, neither Tandon nor the company has named his successor. Before CMF India, Tandon worked with Poco India, which he joined in January 2021 as the Sales Lead. He held the position for nearly a year and six months before he was promoted to the position of Country Head of India of Poco India.
title: CMF's Himanshu Tandon Announces Exit Weeks After Firm Confirms 2026 Phone Strategy

description: The first week of July 2026 is packed with OTT releases across major platforms. Enola Holmes 3 returns with another mystery on Netflix, while Silo Season 3 continues its dystopian sci-fi run on Apple TV+. Pritam and Pedro, Super Subbu, Isakapatnam, Mollywood Times, and Tavvai also streams on different OTT platforms. Check out the top OTT releases for this week.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (June 29 - June 4): Pritam and Pedro, Super Subbu, Enola Holmes 3, Elle, and More

description: The Amazon Prime Day 2026 sale offers discounts on several party speakers catering to different budgets and use cases. The boAt PartyPal 600 tops the list with its 220W output, while the Zebronics Thump 700 and Philips TAX4910/94 provide affordable alternatives. Buyers seeking premium sound can consider the JBL PartyBox Encore 2, whereas the Portronics Iron Beats 5 Prime focuses on powerful bass. These speakers offer varying combinations of battery life, wireless microphones, RGB lighting and TWS support.
title: Best Party Speakers Under Rs 20,000 in India This Amazon Prime Day 2026 Sale: boAt PartyPal 600, JBL PartyBox Encore 2, and More

description: Moto G77 Power will launch in India on July 8. It is set to come in black, blue and red colour options with a hole-punch display design. It features a 6.72-inch full-HD+ display with a 120Hz refresh rate, and the display has Corning Gorilla Glass 7i Protection. It has a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and a 7,000mAh battery. The Moto G77 Power will be available for purcahse through Flipkart.
title: Moto G77 Power Set to Launch in India Next Week; Price Range, Specifications Revealed

description: With the second half of 2026 approaching, Apple is said to be gearing up to introduce the iPhone 18 series in September. The Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to launch the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models this year, while the vanilla iPhone 18 could debut in 2027. But even though the launch is still several months away, the demand for the iPhone 17 series seems to have cooled off. As such, a tipster has suggested that Apple has reduced its production plans for the iPhone 17 lineup by around 15 percent.
title: Apple Reportedly Cuts iPhone 17 Series Production Plans by 15 Percent as Demand Softens

description: Oppo has launched the Enco Air 5 true wireless earbuds in India at Rs. 3,299. The earbuds feature 12mm titanium coated dynamic drivers, support up to 52dB active noise cancellation, and include six microphones with AI backed call noise cancellation. They offer Bluetooth 6.1 connectivity, AI Assistant, AI Translate on compatible devices, and IP55 rated dust and water resistance. Oppo claims up to 54 hours of battery life with the charging case and support for fast charging.
title: Oppo Enco Air 5 With Up to 52dB ANC, Up to 54 Hours Battery Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Amazon Prime Day 2026 sale is set to begin on July 4. The 10th edition of the annual sale event will run through July 6, offering various electronics, including smartphones, true wireless stereo (TWS), smartwatches, tablets, laptops, air conditioners, microwaves, and other smart home appliances, at relatively low prices. You can also get the best deals on wireless headphones with ANC. For reference, the Boat Rockerz Plus 450 ANC, Boat Rockerz 512 ANC, JBL Tune 520 BT, and JBL Tune 760 will be available at discounted prices.
title: Best Noise Cancellation Headphones in India to Buy This Amazon Prime Day: boAt Rockerz 512 ANC, JBL Tune 520 BT and More

description: Samsung Galaxy Jump 5 has been launched in South Korea as the company's new carrier-exclusive smartphone. It is worth noting that the new Galaxy Jump series handset and the Galaxy A27 5G, which was recently launched in India and other countries, are identical in terms of specifications, features, and design. However, the handset is slightly more expensive than the Samsung Galaxy A27 5G. The Galaxy Jump 5 sports a 6.7-inch Full-HD+ (1,080 x 2,340 pixels) Super AMOLED display that refreshes at up to 120Hz, and offers up to 800 nits peak brightness and Corning Gorilla Victus+ protection.
title: Samsung Galaxy Jump 5 Launched With 5,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Red Magic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro was launched in China. It runs Android 16 with Redmagic OS 11.5 and features a 9.06-inch 2.4K (1,504x2,400 pixels) OLED display with up to 165Hz refresh rate and 16:10 aspect ratio. It runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset paired with an Adreno 840 GPU, up to 16GB of LPDDR5T RAM and up to 1TB of UFS 4.1 Pro storage. It carries a RedCore R4 gaming chip and Energy Cube 3.0. It has an RGB lighting system.
title: Red Magic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro Launched With 185Hz OLED Display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip

description: HP has launched the HyperX Omen 16 Valorant Limited Edition gaming laptop in India in collaboration with Riot Games. The laptop features a 16-inch 240Hz IPS display, AMD Ryzen 7 8745HX processor, Nvidia GeForce RTX 5060 GPU, 16GB DDR5 RAM and 1TB SSD. It runs Windows 11 Home and includes OMEN AI optimisation, a HyperAction keyboard, Wi Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, an 83Wh battery with fast charging, and Valorant inspired design elements.
title: HP HyperX Omen 16 Valorant Limited Edition With RTX 5060 GPU, 16GB RAM Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Capcom has moved up the release date for Onimusha: Way of the Sword by three weeks. The upcoming action-adventure title will now launch on September 4 insead of September 25. The new release date means the game will avoid a packed week of video game releases in late September.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Release Date Moved Up to September 4 Amidst Busy Release Period

description: Sony has announced that it is ending disc production for all new games coming to PlayStation consoles starting January 2028. Ampere has now said that the announcement "almost certainly guarantees” that the PS6 won’t launch before 2028. According to the analytics firm, the next-gen console will arrive around the end of 2028.
title: PS6 'Almost Certainly' Won't Arrive Before 2028, Says Analyst After Sony Announces Discless PlayStation Future

description: Honor X80 Pro Max was launched in China earlier this month. Now, the phone has surfaced on the Geekbench benchmark website with model number Honor BSN-AN00. The entry reveals the performance of the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset. It has a 1,095 single-core score testing and a 3,355 multi-core score testing. These results do not show enhanced performance over the Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset.
title: Honor X80 Pro Max Runs Geekbench, Revealing Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 Performance

description: Sennheiser has launched the Accentum Clip clip-on true wireless earbuds in China after introducing them in select global markets in June. The open-ear earbuds feature 12mm dynamic drivers, Bluetooth 6.0, LDAC, SBC and AAC codec support, and Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification. They offer up to 36 hours of battery life with the charging case, IP54-rated dust and splash resistance, dual microphones with AI-backed noise reduction, Google Fast Pair, multipoint connectivity, and a lightweight clip-on design for ambient awareness.
title: Sennheiser Accentum Clip Launched With Up to 36 Hour Battery Life: Price, Features

description: WhatsApp Business announced a new token-based billing model for the AI-powered Meta Business Agent on Wednesday. The Meta-owned messaging platform also reinstated charges for certain business messages as part of a major overhaul of the WhatsApp Business Platform's pricing structure. Instead of individual messages, businesses using the Meta Business Agent will now be charged based on token consumption. The company will also resume charging for service and select utility messages on WhatsApp Business later this year.
title: Meta Introduces Token-Based Pricing for WhatsApp Business AI Agent, Revises Platform Charges

description: Oppo Reno 16 series has been launched in India. The lineup includes the Oppo Reno 16 and Reno 16c. Both smartphones are set to go on sale in India via Amazon and Flipkart in Starry White, Stellar Purple, and Twilight Violet colour options. The Oppo Reno 16 is powered by an octa core Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset, instead of the MediaTek Dimensity chip found on its Chinese counterpart. The Oppo Reno 16c is equipped with a MediaTek Dimensity 7300 SoC, coupled with a 7,000mAh battery, while featuring support for 80W wired fast charging.
title: Oppo Reno 16, Reno 16c  Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Cameras: Price, Specifications

description: Lumio announced the public beta of Project Neo on Thursday. It is an AI-powered content discovery experience built within the company’s TLDR app. The feature lets users search for movies and TV shows on supported Lumio devices simply by sending messages through WhatsApp or Instagram. This, as claimed by Lumio, eliminates the need to navigate multiple streaming apps or type using a TV remote. Project Neo supports natural language queries in nine Indian languages. The feature is currently exclusive to Lumio Vision TVs and Lumio Arc projectors.
title: Lumio Announces Project Neo Public Beta for AI-Powered Content Discovery on Lumio Vision TVs, Arc Projectors

description: WhatsApp recently announced its long-awaited ‘usernames’ feature, which lets users communicate without sharing their phone numbers. While its rollout is still in the infancy stage, the feature is said to have come under the scrutiny of the Government. According to a report, authorities fear it could also make online scams and impersonation attempts more difficult to trace. The Meta-owned instant messaging platform has been asked not to launch “usernames” in India till consultations are complete.
title: Government Reportedly Seeks Explanation From WhatsApp Over Usernames Feature, Asks Meta to Delay Rollout

description: Hide My Email is a feature to keep the personal email addresses of users private. A new report reveals a security flaw in the Hide My Email feature that could allow attackers to uncover users' real email addresses. The vulnerability has remained unresolved for more than a year. Apple is reportedly aware of the issue. The flaw was reportedly spotted by Tyler Murphy, co-founder of the Easy Opt Out service. In March 2026, the company reportedly said that it had addressed the issue through a recent system update.
title: Apple's Hide My Email Vulnerability Could Reveal Users' Real Email Addresses: Report

description: LG has launched the Xboom Bounce and Xboom Grab Bluetooth speakers in India. Developed in collaboration with will.i.am, the portable speakers feature AI Sound, AI Calibration and AI Lighting for automatic audio and lighting adjustments. They support Bluetooth 5.4, LE Audio Auracast, SBC and AAC codecs, and offer IP67 dust and water resistance with Military Standard 810G certification. The Xboom Bounce is priced at Rs. 12,999, while the Xboom Grab costs Rs. 9,999 in black.
title: LG Launches Xboom Bounce, Xboom Grab AI Speakers With Up to 30 Hours Battery Life in India: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy Glasses are expected to be launched later this month. Weeks before its unveiling, purported screenshots from the Galaxy Glasses Manager app, which is said to act as the companion app for the upcoming smart glasses, have surfaced online, hinting at various functionalities it might offer. After granting multiple permissions, the Galaxy Glasses Manager app reportedly takes you through the pairing process.
title: Samsung Galaxy Glasses Spotted Along With Charging Case in Leaked App Screenshots

description: Amazon's Prime Day Sale 2026 is set to begin on July 4, bringing discounts across multiple product categories, including audio devices. Buyers looking for affordable over-ear headphones can consider options such as the boAt Rockerz Plus 450 ANC, JBL Tune 760NC, Soundcore by Anker Q20i, boAt Rockerz 650 Pro, and GoBoult Fluid X Pro. These models offer features such as active noise cancellation, multipoint connectivity, low-latency gaming modes, app support, and battery life ranging from 50 to 80 hours.
title: Best Noise Cancellation Headphones in India Under Rs. 3,000 This Amazon Prime Day: boAt Rockerz 450 ANC, JBL Tune 520 BT and More

description: Sony Interactive Entertainment on Wednesday announced that it will discontinue physical game disc production for all new games releasing on PlayStation consoles starting January 2028. As per the company, new PlayStation titles for the PS5 and potentially the PS6 will only be available digitally through the PlayStation Store and participating retailers once the transition is complete. Existing titles, as well as those launching before January 2028, are not affected by this change and will continue to be offered on Blu-ray discs.
title: Sony Announces End of Physical Game Discs for New PlayStation Titles Starting 2028

description: HP ProBook 4 G2a is the latest addition to the company’s ProBook lineup in India, designed to meet the needs of officegoers and other professionals. At a starting price of Rs. 1,35,000, the new HP ProBook 4 G2a is configurable up to the AMD Ryzen AI 7 445 processor. While it is not an affordable device, it is still a very capable machine. The AMD processor is paired with the AMD Radeon 860M GPU, which is decent for light arcade games but might struggle with 3D rendering. Overall, with a decent touchscreen, long battery life, fast charging, and a solid build, the HP ProBook 4 G2a offers enough to replace your old daily driver.
title: HP ProBook 4 G2a Review: The Reliable New Daily Driver for Work
